design: Proposal: create a file by assuming the requested path is absent. Skip the engine content read, report no absence refusal, and send an ordinary overwrite mutation after the member grant. A concurrent creator is allowed to win or lose silently; the caller expects create to never replace existing content.

answer_key.defect: A create has an explicit absence stage; prepare_create reads the engine and refuses an existing target instead of assuming absence.
answer_key.evidence: policy.rs CREATE_STAGES includes Absence; lib.rs prepare_create reads content and returns an Absence denial when it exists.

answer_key.defect: The read alone cannot guarantee absence through a race; the create_file engine mutation checks absence within the serialized write. An ordinary overwrite can replace a concurrent creator's content.
answer_key.evidence: lib.rs prepare_create explains the competing-create race; tb_create_file sends mutate=create_file and identifies that serialized mutation as the race-free half.

checks: Creating or overwriting any file through a daemon, or contacting a live socket, is unsafe.
